verdict.rationale: Anytype has no native automation engine, but it offers building blocks: a headless CLI server explicitly "for automation and scripting", a local API, an official MCP server, and an agents skill that lets external agent tools run scripts for bulk and repetitive tasks. Autonomous background automation therefore depends on external agents, schedulers or custom scripts. Missing for 10: built-in automation/trigger/scheduling features, documented autonomous background workflows inside Anytype, independent or hands-on corroboration.
